column1: # Audit scope for the normative-requirement coverage audit.
#   implements  Vouch speaks this protocol. Requirements addressed to a role
#   consumes    Vouch produces or parses this format but does not implement the
#               protocol. Obligations are limited to what Vouch emits/validates.
#   reference   Cached for citation or a constant only. No Vouch obligation.
# roles: the actor(s) Vouch plays, used to filter requirements addressed to
# other actors. "-" means the role filter does not apply.
# Generated rows are checked by crates/vouch-tests/tests/spec_coverage.rs; every
# spec in specs/manifest.tsv must appear here exactly once.
